bias.zh: 回调 · 连续第二天守住 30 日均线

read.en: Zscaler slipped 0.3% on Nov 4 to $224.44, trading between $220.08 and $229.85 on light volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($231.8) and rising 10-day ($242.8) and above the rising 30-day ($222.3), 100-day ($179.8) and 200-day ($167.1) averages. MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 2, still above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($265.10), and RSI is 50.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月4日下跌 0.3%，收于 $224.44，盘中区间 $220.08–229.85，成交量偏低。股价位于下行的 5 日（$231.8）和上行的 10 日均线（$242.8）下方，并高于上行的 30 日（$222.3）、100 日（$179.8）和 200 日均线（$167.1）。MACD 于 11月2日下穿信号线，仍在零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$265.10），RSI 为 50。

read.en: No level changed: the $220.08 low held the $220.1–222.3 support (30-day, Oct 14 and Nov 3 lows) again, and the $229.85 high stayed under $231.6–231.8. Resistance is $229.2–231.8 (Nov 3–4 highs, 5-day, Oct 22 low), then $233.2–234.3 and $239–242.8 (10-day). Support is $220.1–222.3, then $214.5 and $203.3. A close above $231.8 would target $234; below $220, $214.5.
